name: Genie Assistant
description: SAP Analytics Cloud custom widget for communicating with the Finance Genie backend using a Databricks OAuth access token.

backendUrl.description: Base URL of the existing Databricks Finance Genie application.

accessToken.description: Short-lived Databricks OAuth 2.0 access token used to authenticate calls to the Databricks App. POC only; do not use a long-lived secret.

askGenie.description: Send a plain-English question to Finance Genie.

clearChat.description: Clear the current chat history and start a new local session.

getSessionId.description: Return the current widget session ID.

setBackendUrl.description: Set the Databricks application URL used by the widget.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Base URL of the Databricks Finance Genie application.

getBackendUrl.description: Return the configured Databricks application URL.

setAccessToken.description: Set the Databricks OAuth access token used by the widget.

getAccessToken.description: Return the currently configured OAuth access token.

onMessageSent.description: Triggered after a user question is submitted.

onResponseReceived.description: Triggered after a Genie response is received.

onError.description: Triggered when the widget encounters an error.
